drill.free_spin.signal: drill running but not touching material

drill.soft.sensation: gentle hum with a slow, even throb

drill.hard.signal: bit grinding hard basalt against high resistance

alert.drill_stall.sensation: a brief silence, then three heavy, slow beats in the index, middle and ring fingers
alert.drill_stall.signal: the drill bit has stopped advancing

event.breakthrough.sensation: one sharp punch in the middle finger that spreads out across the hand and fades
event.breakthrough.signal: the bit punched through the sample

rover.speed.sensation: steady rumble that grows stronger and throbs faster with speed

rover.terrain_left.sensation: random taps on the thumb side, denser and stronger on rougher ground

rover.terrain_right.sensation: random taps on the pinky side, denser and stronger on rougher ground

rover.terrain.sensation: random taps across the hand, denser and stronger on rougher ground

event.impact_left.sensation: one sharp, hard hit on the thumb side that dies away quickly
event.impact_left.signal: a left wheel struck a rock or crater edge

event.impact_right.sensation: one sharp, hard hit on the pinky side that dies away quickly
event.impact_right.signal: a right wheel struck a rock or crater edge

alert.slope.sensation: a brief silence, then a siren: the thumb side and the pinky side take turns, faster and stronger each time
alert.slope.signal: measured LOLA slope under the rover exceeds your personal limit

ui.auth.sensation: your chosen identity pattern: two crisp pulses, three quick pulses, or a wave across the fingers and back

ui.equipment_drill.sensation: a swell that builds in the index and middle fingers, then a firm tap

ui.equipment_rover.sensation: two rolling swells on both edges of the hand (thumb and pinky sides)

ui.confirm.sensation: one short tap on the middle finger

ui.setting_up.sensation: a quick ripple from thumb to pinky that grows stronger

ui.setting_down.sensation: a quick ripple from pinky to thumb that fades

ui.denied.sensation: a low, rough, stuttering buzz that sags
ui.denied.signal: not authorised, or the glove was not recognised

ui.test.sensation: a demonstration of one of the patterns above
